content.comment_body: Hello everyone, After installing [product_name] [version_no], I received an error message. What should I do? Thank you.

Hello [user_name], The issue seems related to Java, specifically JAVA 2 SE. Please check if Java is installed on your system. If not, visit [url] to download it. Installing Java should resolve the error. If it persists, consider updating to [product_name] [version_no], as the older version may be searching for Java in the wrong location. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered a system error after installing [product_name] [version_no] due to a missing or undetected Java runtime environment. This highlights an important prerequisite for the software, leading to installation issues, especially with older versions.
